sources.title: Northwind deployment guide
sources.snippet: Northwind has a two-minute cold start and regional failover.
sources.markdown: Northwind's measured cold start is two minutes. It supports automatic regional failover.

sources.title: Contoso operations guide
sources.snippet: Contoso starts in ten seconds but requires manual regional failover.
sources.markdown: Contoso's measured cold start is ten seconds. Regional failover requires an operator.
